findings.title: A pre-retirement mutation can restore live certification after retirement
findings.evidence: Retirement deletes only the current runId Set entry. The mutation dispatch later awaits executor/transaction settlement and unconditionally adds the runId back, without binding it to the task generation that dispatched the mutation.
reproduction: Start executeActionWithPolicy(write_file) and pause its injected executor.
Call retireLiveCertificationForRun for the same runId.
Release the old mutation and let it settle.
Execute test_run with the same runId.
Both operations observe isInvocationLive() true, so the later task inherits the older operation certification.
findings.verification: Confirmed with transaction I/O and executor effects mocked in memory; no files written and no child process launched.
findings.correction: Advance a run/task epoch on retirement, capture it at executeActionWithPolicy entry before any await, and require it still matches before certifying. Preserve same-task success/reset behavior.

canUseChatLsp with hostFallbackAllowed true and MUTATING operation returns true.

findings.title: New green repository receipts miss dirty bytes when projectRoot is a Git subdirectory
findings.origin: D6 introduces authoritative green use of an existing incorrectly rooted tree-capture helper
findings.description: Git porcelain status always emits repository-root-relative paths. readGitTree resolves those paths against projectRoot, which can be a package directory below the Git root. A dirty package/checked.txt is therefore inspected at /repo/package/package/checked.txt and hashed as missing. Further dirty A-to-B changes preserve that hash, so the new receipt is still considered fresh and adaptable.
reproduction: Use projectRoot /repo/package, Git root /repo, and tracked dirty file /repo/package/checked.txt.
Git ls-files from the package emits checked.txt; Git status emits M package/checked.txt.
Capture a green no-change receipt with empty mutation paths and allowRepositoryScopeForGreenNoChange true.
Change the already-dirty file contents from A to B.
evaluateChatVerifierReceiptCurrencySync(/repo/package, receipt) reports stale false; toExecutorVerifierReceipt reports ok true.
Control: capture from /repo correctly reports stale true after the same contents change.
findings.verification: Reproduced using real capture/currency/adaptation functions with filesystem and Git command output mocked. A separate read-only git -C babel-cli status invocation confirmed root-relative porcelain paths in the actual repository. No fixture files or Git state were written.
findings.correction: Resolve porcelain paths against the actual Git top-level directory, or make Git listing and status scopes consistently relative to the chosen root. Cover dirty and existing untracked A-to-B changes in a real nested-project fixture.

findings.title: Unavailable historical revision scope is no longer marked stale at refresh
findings.description: The new refresh calls evaluateChatVerifierReceiptCurrencySync, then returns the receipt unchanged when that helper returns null. Missing scope or gitBinding produces null. The previous RevisionManager.isReceiptStaleSync explicitly returned stale true for those missing fields. Canonical adaptation still permits an unscoped historical boundRevision, so the receipt can remain green and satisfy a required verifier on the no-change route without an evaluable current revision.
reproduction: Construct a historical structured authoritative green receipt with boundRevision hashes but without scope or gitBinding.
Previous checker RevisionManager.isReceiptStaleSync returns stale true with the reason Receipt has no explicit revision scope or Git binding mode.
New refreshChatVerifierReceiptStalenessSync leaves stale false.
toExecutorVerifierReceipt accepts it.
evaluateCompletionGateForEngine permits a strict requested-verifier completion with inspection evidence and that canonical receipt.
findings.verification: Reproduced entirely in memory through the real old-checker API, new refresh, adaptation, and completion gate. No filesystem read or write was needed.
findings.correction: Keep completion refresh fail closed when revision currency cannot be evaluated. Legitimate non-Git file receipts already have explicit file scope and gitBinding optional, so this need not break that supported case.
